intro: A tracked link is a short address you post in one place. It counts the clicks and shows how far the people who came through it got.

adminOnly.title: Platform administrators only
adminOnly.body: Tracked links are managed by platform administrators. The API answers 403 for anyone else.

note.title: How to read these numbers
note.clicks: Clicks count the times the short link was opened, not unique people: someone who opens it three times counts three. No cookie consent is needed, because nothing about the person is stored. Link previews and known crawlers are counted apart and left out. A mail scanner that opens links like an ordinary browser is not, so clicks from email run high.
note.visitors: Visitors are only the people who accepted cookies on the site, so the figure is a minimum, never a total.
note.accounts: Signups and every step after them are accounts, counted on the server whether or not the person accepted cookies. Each step counts the accounts created in the period that have reached it so far.
note.captureOn: URL capture is on: the campaign details travel in the signup request, so an account created while it is on is counted on its link without a cookie.
note.captureOff: URL capture is off: an account is counted on its link only when the person accepted cookies. Every other account is in the Unattributed accounts row, so the account figures per link are a minimum. The setting is ATTRIBUTION_URL_CAPTURE_ENABLED; read the privacy text that describes it before you turn it on.
note.visitsOff: Visitor counting is switched off on this server (TELEMETRY_VISIT_INGEST_ENABLED), so Visitors reads 0 for every link, whatever people accepted on the site.

funnelError.title: Could not load the funnel numbers
funnelError.body: The links are listed without their counts.

empty.title: No links yet
empty.body: Create one link for each place you post, so every place gets its own numbers.
empty.allArchived: Every link is archived. Turn on Show archived links to see them.

table.caption: Tracked links and their funnel
table.total: {count, plural, one {Total of # link} other {Total of # links}}
table.unattributedHint: Accounts created in the period that belong to no link: no link code, or a campaign value that matches no link. With the link rows, this is every account of the period.
table.stopMark: Most accounts stop before this step
table.legend: Under each count: Visitors and Signups show their share of the clicks; each later step shows its share of the step before. Steps are counted independently, so a later step can be higher than an earlier one. The marked step is where the most accounts of that link stopped. Cost per signup divides the link's whole cost by all of its signups, so it is shown only when the period reaches back to the day the link was created.
table.periodTooShort: Choose a period that covers the link's whole life

urls.title: Links for {code}
urls.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link below and copy it by hand.
urls.shortHint: Use it where space is tight or a clean link matters: social posts, bios, video descriptions, print. It goes through the redirect, and the redirect is what counts the click.
urls.longHint: Goes straight to the page and works without the redirect. Clicks on it are not counted; visitors and accounts from it still are.

form.createdBody: The link is live. Post one of these two addresses:
form.placementHint: A note for you, such as: Show HN, first comment. It is not part of the link.
form.mediumHint: Preselected from the channel. Change it when this placement is different, for example a paid post.
form.campaignHint: One word shared by every link of the same push, such as launch-2026-11. Lowercase letters, digits and . _ ~ + -
form.customPathHint: Starts with /, for example /features. No site address and no ?query.
form.personaHint: Carried to signup with the link, so the app starts from this audience. Filled in from the landing page.
form.costHint: What this placement cost in total, if anything. Leave it empty when it was free.
form.codeHint: The short link will be {path}. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 40 characters.
form.immutable: The code, channel, medium and campaign cannot be changed after the link is created.
form.error: Could not save the link. Please try again.
form.appLandingNote: Nobody is asked about cookies on the app's own pages, so a link that lands here shows no visitors and, with URL capture off, no signups. Land on a page of the site instead: it asks first, then leads to sign-up with the campaign attached.

archive.title: Archive {code}?
archive.body: The short link keeps working, but it sends people to the home page and stops counting clicks. The numbers so far are kept, and the code is never reused. You can unarchive it at any time.
archive.error: Could not archive the link. Please try again.

unarchive.title: Unarchive {code}?
unarchive.body: The short link sends people to {path} again and counts clicks again.
unarchive.error: Could not unarchive the link. Please try again.

errors.placementRequired: Say where you will post it.
errors.placementInvalid: At most 160 characters, on one line.
errors.channelInvalid: Choose a channel from the list.
errors.mediumRequired: Choose a medium from the list.
errors.campaignInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and . _ ~ + - only, starting with a letter or a digit, 64 characters at most.
errors.destinationRequired: Enter the path of the page.
errors.destinationInvalid: Start with / and use only letters, digits and / _ . ~ - (no site address, no ?query, not another /l/ link).
errors.personaInvalid: Choose an audience from the list.
errors.costInvalid: Enter an amount of zero or more, or leave it empty.
errors.currencyInvalid: Enter the three-letter currency code, such as EUR.
errors.codeInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, starting with a letter or a digit, 2 to 40 characters.
errors.codeTaken: Another link already uses this code. A code is never reused, even after its link is archived.

stop.verified: Most stop before verifying their email
stop.onboarded: Most stop before telling us what they make
stop.firstProject: Most stop before a first project
stop.firstRun: Most stop before a first run
stop.firstVideo: Most stop before a first finished video
